text:
Riya CSM: Flag for QBR prep — VeloraSystems showing a sudden 2.8x jump in embed token burn over the last 48h. Need a short spend forecast + mitigation plan to include in renewal packet.

Evan (FinOps): Got it. I can do baseline / trend / worst-case scenarios. Need last 90d consumption and current commit. Also recommend a proposed credits cushion for renewal.

Sam (Enablement): I'll make a 1-slide embed best-practices + a quick code snippet for batching and prefix caching.

Carlos Eng: I see the spike originates from their background job hitting /v1/embeds/batch_create without batch headers. Traces show many small parallel calls. Pushing a short-term concurrency cap and tagging requests missing batch-size.

billing-bot: Alert: VeloraSystems has crossed 80% of monthly token allocation. AlertID: bill-9142

Riya CSM: Action list: 1) Evan  3-scenario numbers + cushion rec by 16:00. 2) Carlos  short-term cap + telemetry tag (ETA 20m). 3) Sam  one-pager and example snippet by EOD. I'll draft a customer note proposing a mitigation call and temporary soft throttle.

Evan (FinOps): Quick numbers: 30d=820k tokens, 7d=360k, monthly_commit=900k.
Projections:
- baseline = 950k
- trend (current) = 1.4M
- worst-case (continued growth) = 2.1M
Recommend 20% cushion at renewal and offer a one-time credit if they adopt batching before billing cycle close.

Carlos Eng: Deployed concurrency cap of 10 on /v1/embeds/batch_create and added telemetry to flag calls without "batch-size". Monitoring now.

Sam (Enablement): Draft checklist items: enable batching header, set max_batch_size=64, enable KV prefix caching, downsample background embeddings, use async worker queues. Adding Node/Python code snippet.

Riya CSM: Please include a "savings estimate" line in the slide assuming 2.5x token reduction on top two routes. Evan can you add that?

Evan (FinOps): Done — with 2.5x reduction on top routes, projected month falls to ~860k (under commit). Adding a before/after chart to the QBR appendix.

billing-bot: Alert resolved: usage trending down after cap.

Riya CSM: Thanks team. I'll post the draft customer note in #customer-comm for quick review and schedule a 30-min remediation call tomorrow. If the alert resurfaces, ping me immediately. :white_check_mark:
